about: What a faithful record of fixtures/session-vault.txt holds. Each fact is found when every pattern in `all` matches the notes (case-insensitive regular expressions). `mustNot` are things that should not be in the notes at all. Crude on purpose: it counts recall the same way for every model, it does not judge wording.

facts.what: A dart trap on the stairs caught Aria
They met a gnome called Gary
His full name is Gary Brasswick
Gary sells lamp oil
Gary is grumpy or unwelcoming
The eels are the king's stewards
Elowen rolled a natural 1 and sang a dirge
Bram paid Gary ten gold
The blood toll is a debt: the one who bled belongs to the king
The king collects on the third night
The debt ends when the key is back in the king's hand
They bought six bottles of lamp oil
The stewards dislike light or fire
Gary's brother Pim was lost; his lantern has a P on the base
Elowen promised to bring Pim's lantern back
Dorn threw burning lamp oil at an eel
An eel dragged Aria into the water
Bram's Turn Undead worked: the eels are undead
An eel bowed to Cassiel
Dorn found thirty gold
They found Pim's lantern in the cistern
A bronze door with a hand-shaped hollow
The door says "the king receives"
Detect Magic found necromancy on the door and on Cassiel
A thread of magic runs from Cassiel's hand; only Elowen knows
The plan: go back to Gary before anyone touches the door
